3. It is further agreed between the parties that the husband will pay a sum of Rs.
200,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Only) to the wife at the time of recording of the statement of first motion by the way of DD/Pay order.

4. It is further agreed between the parties that the husband will pay a sum of Rs.150,000/- (Rupees One Lakh and Fifty Thousand Only) to the wife at the time of recording of the statement of second motion by way of DD/Pay Order.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This application is disposed of.
The present petition under Sections 10 and 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 seeks the following prayers: -
"a) Initiate contempt proceedings against the respondent for wilful breach of an undertaking given to a court with intention of obtaining order dated 28.01.2025 in HMA No. 2110 of 2024 before the Ld. Principal Judge, Family Courts, Central, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.;
b) Impose cost of Rs. 200,000 (Two Lakhs only) on the Respondent for not coming forward to execute or file the second motion;
c) Direct the Respondent to immediately comply with the settlement agreement dated 27-11-2024 executed before the Ld. Counsellor, Tis Hazari Court, Delhi by filing the Second Motion Petition and making the pending payment of Rs. 300,000 (Three Lakhs only);
d) Pass such other Order or Orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
Vide settlement agreement dated 27.11.2024, the following covenants were agreed between the parties: -
"2.
3. It is further agreed between the parties that the husband will pay a sum of Rs.
200,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Only) to the wife at the time of recording of the statement of first motion by the way of DD/Pay order.
4. It is further agreed between the parties that the husband will pay a sum of Rs.150,000/- (Rupees One Lakh and Fifty Thousand Only) to the wife at the time of recording of the statement of second motion by way of DD/Pay Order.
5. It is further agreed between the parties that husband shall pay a sum of Rs.
150,000/- ( Rupees One Lakh and Fifty Thousand Only) to the wife at the time of recording of statement in quashing of FIR No. 987/2014 Under section 498A/406/34 IPC, PS Kalyan Puri, Delhi in Hon'ble High Court of Delhi after second motion and wife shall cooperate and sign all the necessary affidavit and do the needful in quashing of the said FIR."
5. It is pointed out that previously there was a contempt proceeding initiated against the respondent vide CONT.CAS(C) 811/2023 which was disposed of vide order dated 18.08.2023, on the basis of a statement made by the respondent with liberty to the petitioner to revive the contempt petition in case of non-compliance.
6. Issue notice to respondent on petitioner taking necessary steps through all permissible modes returnable on 03.03.2026.
7. Let a compliance affidavit be filed before the next date of hearing.
8.
In case of non-compliance, the respondent shall remain present in Court
